drug_class: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK) inhibitor; tyrosine kinase inhibitor

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces brigatinib plasma concentration and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with brigatinib

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce brigatinib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consider alternative immune support if needed

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may increase brigatinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; inform oncology team of use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases brigatinib plasma concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet during brigatinib therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May alter brigatinib absorption; food effects on ALK inhibitors variable
caution_foods.action: Take brigatinib consistently with or without food; maintain consistent pattern per prescriber guidance

monitoring_notes: Brigatinib has significant hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4; monitor for toxicity signs including gastrointestinal effects, bradycardia, and interstitial lung disease. Confirm use of all supplements and herbal products with oncology team to prevent treatment failure or serious adverse events.
